title: Themis-ml: A Fairness-aware Machine Learning Interface for End-to-end Discrimination Discovery and Mitigation

measurement_description: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It evaluates fairness in machine learning models based on protected classes of gender (female), national origin (foreign worker), and age (age below 25) using the German Credit dataset.
